post.text: Lane Kiffin made the decision to allow the coaches to return in an effort to help new Ole Miss coach Pete Golding, the staff and players maximize the opportunity ahead in the CFP. (There’d already been a decision to let Weis return, made last week.)
post.author_description: College Football Senior Writer for ESPN. Insider for @CollegeGameday. Tips to TipThamel@gmail.com
